name: ale
description: /ale:board: a live task board for an Agentic Label Engineering (ALE) run above the prompt and in a docked pane. Reads `python3 -m ale status --json` and the run's label files; read-only, LLM-free. An experiment on Claude Code function hooks (Mods).

aleCommand.title: ale command
aleCommand.description: The command used to run the ale CLI, split on spaces (no shell). Change this if `python3 -m ale` is not importable from your session's cwd — for example to point at a venv's python or an installed `ale` entry point.
